name: webx/rs-card-grid
title: WebX: Card grid (RoyalSociety)
description: RoyalSociety's card grid (image-led cards). Synced into page.acf.blocks as a "card-grid" block — see wordpress/mu-plugins/webx-blocks-sync.php. Shape differs from ORST's WebX: Card grid (image instead of icon/tag/meta), so it's a separate block, not a shared one — see acf-fields.php and blocks/src/card-grid for the ORST sibling.
